artifacts.name: FCOA Canonical Memory & Intelligence Fabric Node

capability_deltas: FUSE now has a live provider-independent durable scheduling route outside ChatGPT Automations: the approved Superior Logic scheduled gateway can execute no-effect durable missions and write provider-backed receipts.
Durable mission discovery uses GitHub Search rather than only the first 100 open issues, preventing mission invisibility in large repositories.
Canary issue #1648 reached SUCCEEDED through GITHUB-SCHEDULER-V1, received a machine receipt and closed automatically; this is live end-to-end proof of alternate scheduling.
The canonical Alpha-Omega + Formation 60-Minute Finality Prompt is admitted for reuse by FCOA, LocalLLM and other update-aware FUSE controllers.
The prompt mandates multi-stream execution, changed-mechanism recovery, Formation harvesting before new builds, durable transport, proof-before-claim, and minimal owner burden.
route_deltas: On a ChatGPT automation/task-cap error, preserve the mission and use the live durable scheduler route rather than returning the platform cap as the mission-level outcome.
Search all open durable mission issues through a pagination-safe/search-safe mechanism before concluding the queue is empty.
Use the Alpha-Omega/Formation 60-minute prompt as the default aggressive-finality orchestration profile when the owner requests all work to be completed rapidly and automatically.
Run independent workstreams concurrently, but merge state only after proof and readback converge.
Formation must search for reusable mechanisms before any residual build; the second same-semantic failure requires a changed route family.
If an external authority remains irreducible, retain the mission durably and state the exact missing predicate without fabricating completion.
summary: Promote the live durable scheduler canary and Alpha-Omega + Formation 60-Minute Finality Prompt into the stable FUSE update fabric.
warnings: The 60-minute value is a hard execution target, not permission to fabricate terminality when an external provider or authority cannot satisfy a predicate.
The durable scheduler proof covers the admitted no-effect mission path; effectful missions remain separately authority-gated.
Windows owner-PC keyboard/mouse live control remains a separate runtime proof boundary.
